description: Opt-in literal LIKE compilation experiment over the unchanged 1000-row fixture. The scalar control and historical text_like_fallback prefix query retain their exact schedules. Literal exact/prefix/suffix/contains and NOT LIKE filters, CASE projection and grouped CASE cover new admission. An underscore pattern remains a generic fallback control. Dynamic patterns and actual text bindings are checked separately in like_diagnostics.rb.

workloads.name: text_like_fallback
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(score) FROM items WHERE label LIKE 'row5%'

workloads.name: like_exact_filter
workloads.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM items WHERE label LIKE 'row500'

workloads.name: like_suffix_filter
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(score) FROM items WHERE label LIKE '%50'

workloads.name: like_contains_filter
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(score) FROM items WHERE label LIKE '%ow5%'

workloads.name: like_not_prefix_filter
workloads.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM items WHERE label NOT LIKE 'row5%'

workloads.name: like_predicate_projection
workloads.sql: SELECT id, CASE WHEN label LIKE '%ow5%' THEN score + 1 ELSE score - 1 END FROM items ORDER BY id

workloads.name: like_predicate_group
workloads.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN label LIKE 'row5%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, count(*), sum(score) FROM items GROUP BY CASE WHEN label LIKE 'row5%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ORDER BY 1

workloads.name: like_complex_fallback
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(score) FROM items WHERE label LIKE 'row_5%'
